The kinetic energy of an object is given by the formula ½ _mv[2]_. If the velocity is halved, the new velocity would be _v/2_. Substituting this into the formula, we get the new kinetic energy as ½ _m(v/2)[2]_ = ½ _mv[2]/4_ = (1/4) × ½ _mv[2]_ = (1/4) × kinetic energy.
